igRules.note: No website or apply URL is ever printed on Instagram — not on tiles, not in captions. The apply link lives only in the profile bio: conversion CTAs read 'apply → link in bio' / 'apply now → link in bio' (posts 10-12), awareness CTAs point at the handle '@eduflick.ai' (posts 1-9). The eduflickai.com domain is allowed on WhatsApp posters and brochures, never on Instagram. Per-caption rules: hook <=125 chars, exactly one CTA, 3-6 hashtags, exactly one *serif-accent* word, no emoji, no forbidden words; seat counts are FACTS-driven.
